run_upload_script: run the upload.py script to submit code diffs to a code review server
create_rpc_server: create an HttpRpcServer instance to send authenticated requests to a code review server
generate_diff: generate a unified diff from Git, Mercurial, or Subversion working directory
upload_base_files: upload base and current file contents for each file in a patch to the review server
split_patch: split a unified diff patch into separate per-file patch entries
